integrity.analytical_scope: real or complex Hilbert spaces of dimension at least two

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns positive invertible first inputs and a rank-one spiked second input; it does not cover arbitrary positive operators. Standard rank-one singular-value and Kantorovich ingredients are acknowledged. Independent validation and definitive priority checks remain outstanding.
title: Two-outlier rigidity and sharp Kantorovich amplification for spiked near-spectral endpoints
